verdict.rationale: Beamer collects feedback through NPS surveys, comments and reactions, and it offers integrations, webhooks and a HubSpot sync. However, nothing in the evidence shows a native workflow builder that triggers SLAs, trial extensions or discount offers from feedback events. Webhooks and integrations are only building blocks for constructing such automation elsewhere, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build automated workflows for SLAs, trial extensions, and discount offers triggered by feedback events
